tools.name: Note Repeat
tools.author: ShoveD01
tools.description: A fuller note repeat: hold a pad and it repeats from 1 bar down to 1/64, plain, triplet or dotted, optionally with a Euclidean or random pattern, and the rate and loudness can follow the velocity or the live pad pressure.
how_to_use: Row 0: RATE (1/1 to 1/64), the type (- plain, T triplet, . dotted), V: OFF / PRS (velocity of the hit sets the rate) / LIV (live pad pressure sets the rate and the hit velocity)
Row 1: PAT OFF / EUC (Euclidean) / RND (random), N = steps, H = hits, R = rotate (EUC) or seed (RND)
Hold a pad: it repeats until you let go; with a sequence running the first hit waits for the next grid line

tools.name: Resample
tools.author: ShoveD01
tools.description: Records what the MPC is playing (sequence and pads, optionally mixed with the line input) into a new mono or stereo sample and puts it on a pad. Length can be a number of bars from the tempo, or as much as fits in sample memory.
how_to_use: Set L (length: MAX / 1/4 / 1/2 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 bars), the source (OUT = MPC output, MIX = plus the line input; the OS Record page source must be IN for MIX), M (input monitoring - / +) and 1CH / 2CH
SHIFT + pad starts recording; the sample will go on that pad (current bank)
SHIFT + any pad stops: the sample is finished, becomes the current sample and is put on the pad (mono voice overlap, mute group 1)
A fixed length stops by itself. Pads without SHIFT are left to the OS.
